2026_02_MIA_SF.headline: Miami’s road start runs into San Francisco’s veteran core
2026_02_MIA_SF.paragraph1: Miami travels to San Francisco for another early road test against a 49ers team that returned to the postseason last year with its veteran offensive core intact. The Dolphins’ schedule analysis highlights Christian McCaffrey, George Kittle and Trent Williams as the center of that challenge, while San Francisco’s Week 2 viewing guide confirms the Levi’s Stadium matchup. Miami must prevent the 49ers from living in favorable down-and-distance; San Francisco wants its playmakers operating from a balanced menu rather than obvious passing situations.
2026_02_MIA_SF.model_rationale: San Francisco’s veteran skill group against Miami’s early-down defense determines whether its offense can preserve balance and keep the Dolphins from dictating obvious passing situations.
